---
name: Bug report
about: Something does not look or work right on your watch
labels: bug
---

**Watch model and Wear OS version**
e.g. Galaxy Watch 7, Wear OS 6

**Noma Wheels version**
e.g. 1.4

**What happened / what you expected**

**Your Customize settings** (palette, accent, always-on style, anything unusual)

**Log output** (run right after selecting the face)
```
adb logcat -d | findstr -i watchface
```

**Screenshot or screen recording** (optional)
